name: Edinburgh Napier University
description: Edinburgh Napier University is located in the popular city of Edinburgh, Scotland. The university itself has some interesting and highly ranked courses – it is number 1 worldwide for timber engineering, sustainable construction, and wood science (and top 10 in the Uk for building and civil engineering), and Screen Academy Scotland, which is very well renowned, is part of the university - Napier is in the top 10 of universities in the UK for Drama. It is also ranked as the top modern university in Scotland. Timestamps Updated
